m_hand.speaker: MARCEL
lines: This is where I stop existing. Her name is not Sylvie, and Sylvie is her name. From the calvary on, you are hers.
Here I end. She is called Sylvie, which is not her name and is her name completely. You belong to her now.

s_cold.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: Étienne wrote of you. Your answers held — and one of them needed help to stand. Understand me: on my stretch of the line, nothing of yours will need help.
Word came up the line. You passed, and you lied once on the way through. That once is spent. There is no second one with me.

s_sharp.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: Étienne says your ears work — that you heard the false note in the other one. Good. Where we walk, ears are worth more than papers.
The word from Étienne: this one listens. Keep listening. It is the only weapon they let you carry now.

s_plain.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: Étienne vouches for you. He does not spend that often. Try to be worth the price.
You come vouched for, which costs Étienne something. Spend it slowly.

q_player.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: Anything to say before you become my dull cousin Jean for two days?
Speak now if you must. Jean Caillet has nothing to say, ever, and you become him in one minute.

choices.text: Thank you. Both of you. I won't forget what Marcel did.

m_bye.speaker: MARCEL
lines: Forget me completely. That is the thanks. Bonne route, l'Américain.
The best thanks is to forget my face by the next field. Allez.

s_biz.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: Two days, if you are boring. Be boring.
Close, if you are dull enough. Be dull.

s_nod.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: He does not talk. Étienne undersold you.
A nod. Good — Jean is already arriving.

s_rules.speaker: SYLVIE
lines: From here: ten steps behind me, eyes down. If I stop to fix my shoe, you find something fascinating in a hedge. We sleep over my shop tonight; tomorrow, the train.
The rules: ten steps back, eyes on the road. I stop, you stop somewhere else. Tonight the room over the shop; tomorrow we buy you a train ticket with your own dull face.
